featuresLab.title: Features Lab
featuresLab.androidNavBody: On Android devices with 3-button or 2-button soft navigation, the bottom sheet and bottom toast automatically inject dynamic bottom margins so actions are never obscured.
featuresLab.stackedBody: Opens a modal bottom sheet which can trigger a second modal sheet stacked on top, with layered backdrops and gestures.
featuresLab.keyboardBody: Features BottomSheetTextInput with auto-expanding interactive keyboard avoidance without clipping buttons.
featuresLab.toastSubtitle: Powered by react-native-toast-message with custom native HUD capsule styling and soft navigation clearance.
featuresLab.simulateBody: These trigger the exact toast format presented on ERR_NETWORK or 5xx server responses.
featuresLab.serverErrorMessage: Internal Server Error (500). Please try again later.
featuresLab.warningMessage: Network bandwidth is low. Image sync paused.
featuresLab.cancelBody: Cancels all pending HTTP requests across the application.
featuresLab.overviewSubtitle: All components adhere to clean architecture, zero-jank New Architecture standards, and complete unit test coverage.
featuresLab.stackTabView: High performance tabs powered by pager-view with smooth swipe physics.
featuresLab.stackBottomSheet: Official Software Mansion modal sheets with stacking and keyboard avoidance.
featuresLab.stackToast: Native HUD capsule bottom toast with Android navigation bar safety.
featuresLab.stackLoader: Reference-counted imperative loader and API cancellation controller.
featuresLab.stackUnistyles: Ultra-fast stylesheet engine with dynamic runtime theme support.
featuresLab.stackStorage: High speed storage and predictable state orchestration.
